title: OmniLet compiler rule-table row v1
description: Machine contract for one row of the seven-part rule table (tagMap/directiveMap/eventMap/lifecycleMap/exprWhitelist/styleRules/capabilityRules). Consumers: ajv gate in @omnilet/compiler (T5), table authoring. Enum source of truth mirrors compiler/src/types.ts.

kind.description: Owning table of the seven-part rule table (D5 table-driven compiler).

s.description: Source token (tag / directive / event / lifecycle hook / expr pattern / style rule / capability name).

t.description: Target token; absent for whitelist/passthrough-style rows.

primitive.description: Kernel primitive the row maps onto (closed 8-value set, D21 mixed-DSL vocab).

forItem.description: v-for item-alias attr name (D22 Card 1): what splitDirective emits for the loop item alias. Absent = wechat literal `wx:for-item`.

forIndex.description: v-for index-alias attr name (D22 Card 1): what splitDirective emits for the loop index alias. Absent = wechat literal `wx:for-index`.

golden.description: Expected compiler output fragment for this row (byte-normalized per NORMALIZATION.md). Fail-closed: a row without a golden is not testable.
